mods.name: Run Stalker
mods.description: The mod is made especially for melharucos, but can be used by other people, too. Its only function is to start a S.T.A.L.K.E.R. game once the player dies in Hardcore mode.

readmeSummary: ENG: This is a Fabric 1.17 mod made specifically for melharucos. Its only function is to start a S.T.A.L.K.E.R. game once the player dies in a Hardcore singleplayer world.
